title: Reading Drill — Weighing Parcels at a Small Shop
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Weighing Parcels at a Small Shop
passages.body:
**A** A shop introduced a parcel scale beside the tills. Customers who brought a box without its final packaging sometimes received a weight estimate lower than the finished item.

**B** Staff placed scrap paper and tape beside the scales so customers could close the parcel before measuring it. A line on the counter indicated the maximum size the shop could accept.

**C** The first week was slower because staff explained the new process repeatedly. Later a short sign above the scale told customers where to write the reference number.
